We are looking for a **results\-oriented digital marketer** to elevate the presence of our luxury event décor brand and increase brand awareness among qualified audiences\.

Our priority is to build visibility across **Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn**, with the option to explore Google Ads if it makes strategic sense for reach, retargeting or campaign support\.

### What We Need Help With

We are looking for someone who can develop and optimise a clear, data\-driven marketing strategy focused on:

- Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn marketing
- Luxury\-focused brand messaging and copywriting
- Content strategy and campaign planning
- Instagram Stories and Reels
- Paid social advertising
- Audience research and segmentation
- Creative recommendations for supplied imagery and event footage
- Hashtag and keyword strategy
- Campaign tracking and analytics
- Google Ads recommendations, if strategically appropriate
- Retargeting opportunities
- Competitor and local market research
- Ongoing campaign optimisation

We will provide imagery, footage from past events and access to our brand guidelines\. You will bring the channel expertise, copywriting skills and optimisation experience needed to turn those assets into effective campaigns\.

### Required Deliverables

The initial project must include:

- A **30\-day content calendar** tailored to Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn
- Recommended posts, Stories and Reels
- Suggested hashtags and posting times
- Paid social audience definitions
- Creative recommendations
- Initial ad campaigns built and ready to launch
- A weekly performance dashboard covering reach, engagement and impressions
- Weekly recommendations for optimisation and next steps

### Our Goal

Our primary goal is to increase brand awareness and keep our luxury event décor brand front\-of\-mind for:

- Event planners
- Brides and engaged couples
- Corporate event organisers
- Local businesses and venues
- Other relevant decision\-makers in the events industry

Success will be measured by:

- Steady follower growth among qualified audiences
- Noticeable increases in post engagement
- Improved reach and impressions
- Stronger visibility within the local events scene
- Increased conversation and awareness around our décor services during the first month

We want our brand to be positioned as **luxury, elegant and distinctive**, with messaging that reflects the quality of our styling and attracts premium clients\.

### Ideal Freelancer

We are looking for someone who:

- Has proven experience with Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn marketing
- Understands paid social strategy and campaign optimisation
- Can write polished, luxury\-focused marketing copy
- Has experience creating content calendars and campaign plans
- Understands audience targeting and retargeting
- Can interpret performance data and make practical recommendations
- Has experience with Google Ads or can assess when it would support our objectives
- Has worked with wedding, event, luxury, hospitality or similar brands
- Can provide examples of previous results and relevant work

### Initial Project

The first stage will focus on creating and implementing a **30\-day brand awareness and content strategy**, setting up paid social campaigns, and establishing a clear weekly reporting process\.

If the initial project goes well, we are interested in ongoing marketing support and campaign optimisation\.

### To Apply

Please send:

1. Your portfolio or examples of relevant work
2. Examples of campaigns you have managed for luxury, wedding, event or local brands
3. Your experience with Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn marketing
4. Your approach to increasing brand awareness among qualified audiences
5. Examples of dashboards or reports you provide
6. Your proposed price for the initial 30\-day project
7. Your monthly price for ongoing management

**Please do not send a generic marketing proposal\.** Tell us specifically how you would increase awareness for a luxury event décor brand across Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, and how you would use analytics to guide optimisation\.

We are looking for someone who can combine creative luxury\-focused messaging with measurable, data\-driven marketing\.

full_description:
I am looking for a WordPress developer to build a secure property-manager portal within my existing Mako Property Care website.

The aim is to provide real estate/property managers with a simple online portal where they can manage their properties and request maintenance services from Mako.

Existing Technology

The website is built on WordPress and I intend to use:

Gutenberg
Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
Forminator or similar forms
A lightweight custom WordPress plugin where required
I want to avoid Elementor or a separate custom application unless there is a strong technical reason.

Core Portal Workflow

The main workflow should be:

Property Manager Login → My Properties → Select Property → Request a Job → Track Job → View Job Report/Photos/Documents

Main Features Required

1. Secure Property Manager Login

Individual property-manager accounts
Property managers cannot access WordPress administration
Each manager can only see their own assigned properties
2. My Properties

Display properties assigned to the logged-in manager
Property cards showing photo, address, property ID and status
“View Property” and “Request a Job” buttons
Must be dynamically filtered by the logged-in user
3. Individual Property Page
Each property should have:

Property information
Access instructions
Special instructions
Request a Job
Current Jobs
Job Reports
Photos
Documents
4. Maintenance Request Form
Using Forminator or similar:

Property — automatically selected
Service required
Description
Priority
Preferred date
Photo upload
Additional information
Services will initially include lawn mowing, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, window cleaning, house washing, roof cleaning and other external property maintenance.

5. Jobs
Property managers should be able to see:

Job number
Property
Service
Status
Requested/scheduled/completed dates
Job details
6. Job Reports
Mako staff should be able to upload reports containing:

Work completed
Before/after condition
Recommendations
Before/after photos
PDF report
Property managers should only see reports belonging to their properties.

7. Documents
Allow property-specific documents such as:

Quotes
Invoices
Job reports
Certificates
Photos
Other documents
Security

This is particularly important.

A property manager must not be able to access another manager’s property, job, report or document by changing a URL or otherwise bypassing the portal.

Access must be controlled at the server/WordPress level, not simply by hiding information from the screen.

Future Integration

The system should be designed so that we can later integrate with ServiceM8 or Formitize for job management, scheduling, reporting and other automation.

I do not require that integration in the initial build.

My Priority

I want a professional but simple and affordable MVP that I can manage myself after development.

I need to be able to:

Add a property → assign it to a property manager → publish → property automatically appears in that manager’s portal.

The portal must be mobile-friendly and work well on phones, tablets and desktop.

Initial Quote Request

Estimated development cost
Estimated timeframe
What plugins/licences you would require
What you would recommend changing or simplifying
Ongoing maintenance costs, if any
Whether you can build the system so it can later integrate with ServiceM8 or Formitize

full_description:
Title: Senior engineer — scale a Laravel + ClickHouse email-sending platform to 1M+/day

Description:

We run a Laravel/PHP email-sending platform (MySQL, ClickHouse) that delivers through ESP/SMTP relays (Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, SparkPost). It already has a full sending control plane — per-server warmup quotas, a 3-layer volume throttle, reservation accounting, provider cooldowns, SMTP classification, MX classification. It works today at low volume. We need a senior engineer to re-architect the hot paths so it reliably scales from current volume to 100k → 250k → 500k → ~1,000,000+ messages/day without violating per-domain / per-provider / warmup limits.

Concrete work areas:

Rate-accounting & distributed concurrency — we have both a file-based and a Redis-cache-reservation path; benchmark contention/correctness under multiple worker hosts and move hot counting to atomic, shardable accounting.
Recipient selection — replace a growing per-wave exclusion query with an indexed dispatch-ledger/cursor design.
Dispatch throughput — replace serial ~200-recipient waves with a design that keeps workers saturated without flooding the queue.
ClickHouse ingestion — replace one-insert-per-event with buffered/bulk batch inserts (this is a first-class requirement).
Queue backend + multi-host worker topology, MySQL indexing/EXPLAIN at 30M+ rows, load testing and observability.

Required (must have all):

Strong PHP/Laravel (queues, jobs, Eloquent)
Distributed systems / high concurrency: correct concurrent rate limiting, distributed locks, atomic counters (Redis/Lua), reservation & idempotency
Laravel queue/worker scaling (database vs Redis vs SQS), Supervisor, multi-host fleets
MySQL at scale: indexing, EXPLAIN, hot-row contention, tens of millions of rows
ClickHouse in production — MergeTree schema, batched/bulk ingestion, avoiding part-per-insert (must have operated it, not just queried it)
Proven experience operating a 500k–1M+/day email-sending system (this is the key differentiator)
Load testing + production observability

Nice to have: PowerMTA/Halon/MailerQ (only relevant if we later run our own MTA — not required now); deliverability fundamentals; ex-ESP engineer (SendGrid/Twilio, Mailgun, SES, SparkPost).

How this starts: a paid ~20–40 hour architecture + benchmark review first — assess the production system, benchmark the bottlenecks, and deliver a target architecture + migration plan + implementation estimate. Implementation is a separate, larger engagement awarded after that review.

To bid, you MUST answer these two questions (bids that don't will be ignored):

How would you batch our ClickHouse event ingestion (sends/opens/clicks/bounces) to avoid part-per-insert at ~1M events/day, and how do you handle failures/duplicates?
How would you design a distributed rate limiter so 20 workers across 3 hosts never exceed a per-provider hourly cap, with correct behavior if a worker dies mid-send?

Please link a specific project where you scaled email sending or high-throughput ClickHouse ingestion. Do not bid if your approach relies on rotating domains/IPs or "guaranteed inbox" tactics — we protect long-term sender reputation.

Job Description: Looking for a creator to record short 5 to 10 second video clips holding a handwritten sign for a digital ad. No speaking required.

Exact Sign Copy: Don't have a Website? We will build you one for free. @alwaysfreewebsite

Video Requirements:

Length: 5 to 10 seconds per take.
Action: Hold the sign steady towards the camera and smile, or point to the text.
Framing: Face can be in the shot, or framed from the neck/chest down focusing purely on the sign and hands. Both styles are accepted, but both styles are preffered.
Format: Vertical video (9:16) for TikTok / Instagram Reels. Crisp quality (1080p or 4K from phone).
Sign: Plain white paper or cardstock written with a bold black marker. 100% legible.
Lighting: Bright, clear lighting with an uncluttered background. Solid-color shirt with no logos.
Deliverables:

3 to 5 video takes (multiple variations: with face smiling, without face pointing at sign, etc.).
Raw video files (MP4 or MOV).
Full commercial advertising rights.
48-hour turnaround.
